subject.title: refactor(agents): converge run staleness policy onto diagnostic activity owner

question: Should diagnostic activity permanently own the stale-takeover threshold shared by reply reclamation and embedded steering?
rationale: The patch deliberately moves a cross-layer ownership boundary and carries a protected `maintainer` signal, so automation can verify equivalence but cannot provide final ownership approval.

options.title: Approve diagnostic ownership
options.body: Keep the shared resolver and merge after redacted exact-head runtime proof confirms both timing boundaries.

options.title: Retain registry ownership
options.body: Rework or close the PR if reply reclamation and embedded steering should continue to own separate policy constants.

recommendation.title: Approve diagnostic ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the shared resolver and merge after redacted exact-head runtime proof confirms both timing boundaries.
